title: Anchor-prompt fingerprinting and streaming-tool orchestrator smoke harness
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a compact, deterministic smoke harness that validates multi-protocol API compatibility across streaming, function/tool calling, and structured-output paths using a seeded corpus of 'anchor prompts'. The harness should exercise partial-JSON emission, tool-call handshakes, KV-cache priming scenarios, and multi-stream interleaving to catch regressions before canary deploys. Focus is on actionable failures (schema break, loss of toolcall metadata, sequence reordering) rather than exhaustive behavioral diffs.
acceptance_criteria: Anchor corpus of 120 prompts covering short/long contexts, embeddings-only, toolcall-first, and JSON-schema-heavy prompts exists and is checked into repo
CI job 'anchor-smoke' runs on PRs touching streaming, toolcall, or structured-output codepaths and fails if >2% of anchor seeds regress beyond allowed thresholds
Harness can emulate downstream tool endpoints (HTTP noop, auth shim, rate-limited stub) and validate function-call handshakes and retry semantics
Partial-JSON recovery assertions added: harness flags malformed JSON that is not recoverable and records token offset and model variant causing it
Dashboard tile created in Console showing anchor-smoke pass rate over last 30 days and top 3 failing seeds
implementation_notes: Use deterministic random seeds and fixed model variants to make fingerprints reproducible across CI runs
Normalize tokenization differences by running a light token normalization pass (strip non-deterministic whitespace, canonicalize quotes) before comparing outputs
Implement a streaming window comparator that tolerates minor timing jitter but flags ordering inversions and dropped toolcall tokens
Emulator for tools should support delayed responses to verify KV cache priming and fallbacks
Keep harness lightweight: prefer unit/integration-level checks over long-running system tests to keep CI latency small
test_plan: Create anchor corpus in fixtures/anchors/ with YAML metadata per prompt (seed, expected schema, tolerated diff thresholds)
Add new CI workflow 'anchor-smoke' that runs against a matrix of runtime builds and a representative small set of model-variants
Integrate a flakiness tracker: allow tests to be retried up to 1 time in CI and mark seeds as flaky in dashboard
Add golden-oracle shim that records canonical structured-output patterns for each seed to a golden-store bucket for regression triage
Schedule nightly full anchor run that runs at lower frequency and wires results to PagerDuty when failing post-triage thresholds
comments: 2025-02-10 Priya Nair: Triage - split from ENG-62309. Goal is a compact CI smoke harness that gives high signal on API contract regressions for streaming+toolcalls. Assigned to Jordan.

2025-02-12 Jordan Blake: Spike results - ran 40 seeds locally against runtime-1.18 and found two recurring failure modes: (1) partial-JSON termination when stream chunk boundaries split object keys, (2) function-call metadata lost when an intermediate shim rewrites headers. Repro steps added to the design doc.

2025-02-14 Jordan Blake: Decision - implement token-normalization pre-compare and a 'chunk-aware' JSON reassembler before asserting schema validity. This reduces false positives from whitespace/tokenizer edge cases.

2025-02-16 Emma Chen (review): Feedback - add explicit assertions for toolcall idempotency and retry headers; please include a small emulated auth shim to cover header propagation bugs seen in customer incident INC-2024-11.

2025-02-18 Jordan Blake: Implemented a minimal tool-emulator supporting delayed responses and 429 semantics; pushed PR #1897. Hooked up initial CI job that runs the 20 highest-signal anchors. Initial run shows 3 flaky seeds; added them to flaky list and created follow-up ENG-24010 to investigate model variant sensitivity.

2025-02-20 Priya Nair: PM review - good progress. Please add dashboard tile and make nightly full-run gating optional for canary deploys. Confirming P1 priority and targeting runtime-1.20 release inclusion. Marking this ticket In Progress.

2025-02-20 Jordan Blake: Next steps - stabilize flaky seeds, expand anchor set to 120, finalize CI failure thresholds (currently set to 2% fail) and document triage playbook for failures in Confluence.
